'''Rayan Rupert''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|r|aɪ|.|ən|_|r|uː|ˈ|p|ɛər}} {{respelling|RYE|ən|_|roo|PAIR}};<ref>{{cite press release |title=2023–24 start of season NBA pronunciation guide |date=24 October 2023 |url=https://www.nba.com/news/2023-24-start-of-season-nba-pronunciation-guide |access-date=18 May 2024 |website=NBA.com}}</ref> born 31 May 2004) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Delaware Blue Coats]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He previously played for the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].

==Early career==
Rupert is a graduate of the INSEP Academy in France.<ref name="breakers-sign">{{cite web |date=10 June 2022 |title=French Phenom Rayan Rupert the Latest NBL Next Star |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/french-phenom-rayan-rupert-the-latest-nbl-next-star |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230328023049/https://nbl.com.au/news/french-phenom-rayan-rupert-the-latest-nbl-next-star |archive-date=28 March 2023 |access-date=28 March 2023 |work=NBL.com.au}}</ref> He is of Martiniquais<ref>{{cite web |date=25 October 2022 |title=À 18 ans, le basketteur martiniquais Rayan Rupert conquiert l'Australie et se rapproche de la NBA |url=https://la1ere.francetvinfo.fr/a-18-ans-le-basketteur-martiniquais-rayan-rupert-conquiert-l-australie-et-se-rapproche-de-la-nba-1334200.html |access-date=21 January 2025 |work=Outre-mer la 1ère}}</ref> and Moroccan<ref>{{cite tweet |number=1672177589702606849 |user=ProsMarocains |title=Rayan Rupert with his Moroccan mother ❤️🇲🇦. #NBADraft2023 We apologise for the previous post. |author=AlmarssadPro |date=23 June 2023 |access-date=21 January 2025}}</ref> descent.

==Professional career==
===Centre Fédéral (2019–2021)===
Between 2019 and 2021, Rupert played for [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball|Centre Fédéral]] in the French [[Nationale Masculine 1|NM1]].<ref name="australiabasket">{{cite web |title=Rayan Rupert |url=https://basketball.australiabasket.com/player/Rayan-Rupert/505363 |url-access=subscription |access-date=28 March 2023 |website=AustraliaBasket.com}}</ref>

===Pôle France (2021–2022)===
Rupert continued play in the [[Nationale Masculine 1|NM1]] in the 2021–22 season with Pôle France.<ref name="australiabasket" />

===New Zealand Breakers (2022–2023)===
On 10 June 2022, Rupert signed with the [[New Zealand Breakers]] for the [[2022–23 NBL season]] as part of the league's Next Stars program.<ref name="breakers-sign" /> The Breakers had previously seen fellow Frenchmen [[Hugo Besson]] and [[Ousmane Dieng]] selected in the [[2022 NBA draft]].

===Portland Trail Blazers (2023–2026)===
Rupert was selected by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] in the second round of the [[2023 NBA draft]] with the 43rd overall pick<ref>{{cite web|title=Trail Blazers select Rayan Rupert in second round of the 2023 NBA Draft|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-select-rayan-rupert-in-second-round-of-the-2023-nba-draft|date=22 June 2023|website=NBA.com|access-date=22 June 2023}}</ref> and on 4 July 2023, he signed with the Blazers.<ref>{{cite web |date=4 July 2023 |title=Trail Blazers Sign Rayan Rupert |url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-sign-rayan-rupert |access-date=12 November 2023 |website=NBA.com}}</ref> Rupert made 39 appearances (including 12 starts) for Portland during his rookie campaign, recording averages of 4.0 points, 2.4 rebounds, and 1.6 assists.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Rayan Rupert 2023–24 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/5099752/type/nba/year/2024|access-date=July 7, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}}</ref>

Throughout his rookie and sophomore seasons, he was often [[NBA G League#Standard assignment|assigned]] to the [[Rip City Remix]].<ref>{{cite web |title=2023–2024 Rip City Remix Transaction History |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Rip-City-Remix/67/Transaction_History/2024 |access-date=21 January 2025 |website=RealGM.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=2024–2025 Rip City Remix Transaction History |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Rip-City-Remix/67/Transaction_History/2025 |access-date=21 January 2025 |website=RealGM.com}}</ref> Rupert made 52 appearances for the Trail Blazers during the [[2024–25 NBA season]], averaging 3.0 points, 1.3 rebounds, and 0.5 assists.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Rayan Rupert 2024–25 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/5099752/type/nba/year/2025|access-date=July 7, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}}</ref>

Rupert played in 48 games for Portland during the [[2025–26 NBA season|2025–26 season]], recording averages of 2.9 points, 1.8 rebounds, and 0.7 assists.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Rayan Rupert 2025–26 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/5099752/type/nba/year/2026|access-date=July 7, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}}</ref> Rupert was waived by the Blazers on February 20, 2026.<ref>{{cite web|title= Trail Blazers Convert Sidy Cissoko To Standard NBA Contract |url= https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-convert-sidy-cissoko-to-standard-nba-contract |website=NBA.com|date=February 20, 2026|access-date=February 20, 2026}}</ref>

===Memphis Grizzlies (2026)===
On 22 February 2026, Rupert was signed to a 10-day contract by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].<ref>{{cite web|title= Grizzlies Sign Rayan Rupert to 10-Day Contract|url= https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-rayan-rupert-to-10-day-contract |website=NBA.com|date=February 22, 2026|access-date=February 23, 2026}}</ref> On 4 March, following the expiration of his 10-day deal, Memphis signed Rupert to a two-way contract.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies Sign Rayan Rupert to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-rayan-rupert-to-two-way-contract|access-date=March 8, 2026|website=nba.com|language=en}}</ref> On 5 April, Rupert recorded his first career triple-double, compiling 33 points, 10 rebounds, and 10 assists (all career-highs) as the Grizzlies lost to the [[2025–26 Milwaukee Bucks season|Milwaukee Bucks]], 115–131.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bucks Defeat Grizzlies Despite Rupert's Triple-Double|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/bucks-defeat-grizzlies-despite-ruperts-triple-double|access-date=April 13, 2026|website=nba.com|language=en}}</ref> He appeared in 16 games (including eight starts) for Memphis, averaging career-highs in points (12.2), rebounds (6.4), and assists (2.1).

=== Philadelphia 76ers (2026–present) ===
On July 8, 2026, Rupert signed a two-way contract with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=PHILADELPHIA 76ERS SIGN RAYAN RUPERT TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT |url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/philadelphia-76erssign-rayan-rupert-to-two-way-contract |website=July 8, 2026 |publisher=[[Philadelphia 76ers]]}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Rupert's father, [[Thierry Rupert|Thierry]], was a EuroLeague player and captain of the French national team while his sister, [[Iliana Rupert|Iliana]], was the 12th overall pick in the [[2021 WNBA draft]]. His cousin, Kameron Jones, a cancer survivor, is a chemistry major at UMBC.<ref>{{cite web |date=10 June 2022 |title=Basketball: New Zealand Breakers sign French teenager Rayan Rupert |url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/basketball-new-zealand-breakers-sign-french-teenager-rayan-rupert/5LTVAKOEVSZ4IHOPY6QGIZAHUM/ |access-date=28 March 2023 |website=NZHerald.co.nz}}</ref>

Rupert and fellow NBA player [[Adama Bal]] grew up together in France as childhood best friends; the two later became teammates on the [[2025–26 Memphis Grizzlies season|Memphis Grizzlies]] during the [[2025–26 NBA season]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=From France to Memphis, childhood best friends reunite on Grizzlies|url=https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/nba/grizzlies/2026/04/08/memphis-grizzlies-rayan-rupert-adama-bal-france-basketball/89458028007/?gnt-cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=false&gca-epti=z115543p118950l004450c118950u116943e006700v115543&gca-ft=210&gca-ds=sophi|access-date=July 7, 2026|website=commercialappeal.com|language=en}}</ref>
